scope: Authenticated channel-neutral issuer delivery API over the D1 encrypted idempotent delivery store
implemented: POST registers or recovers an issuer-scoped idempotent signed entitlement package without returning the claim secret.
GET retrieves the exact pending package after seller authentication and same idempotency key; after acknowledgement it returns status only.
PATCH acknowledges the exact claim for the same seller/order key and clears encrypted claim-code material from D1.

The endpoint validates bounded JSON, content type, seller bearer token digest, issuer identity, signed claim/code, encryption keyring, and request idempotency; it fails closed when configuration is absent or mismatched.
Route is included in the Vinext production build at /api/internal/rockstar/entitlement-deliveries.
next: Integrate seller checkout, refunds, and delivery callbacks only after issuer contracts and sandbox credentials are available.
